# netcup_server_guest_agent (Data Source)

The data of the guest agent of a netcup server (SCP REST API).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netcup_server_guest_agent" "example" {
  server_id = 12345
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `server_id` (Number) Id of the server.

### Read-Only

- `guest_agent_available` (Boolean) Whether the guest agent is available.
- `guest_agent_data` (String) Data of the guest agent as JSON, use `jsondecode` to read it. Its content changes with the agent version.
